title: The Source
studio_context: Blue Note album arranged with saxophonist Yann Jankielewicz; a jazz big band around his Afrobeat.

drum_performances.name: Tony Allen
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His late statement as a leader, bringing Afrobeat back to the jazz he learned from: Blakey and Roach meet Africa 70.

drums.description: A big band around snare on one, his own pattern at the centre of the arrangement.
